notes.title: 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》october development log
notes.content:
Throughout October, I felt I had very little development time at my disposal.
  After the seven-day National Day holiday, I began to enter this involuntary cycle, adjusting the make-up shift, continuing to move, the company worked more overtime and traveling on weekends, although I couldn't help myself, I also made as much material for the game as possible, improved the visual effects, and optimized the overall performance.

[b] 1. Character animation[/b]
  This month, because I have seven days of discretionary vacation, I have accelerated the pace of character production, and 6 new characters have been completed and implemented, 4 characters are waiting to be animated, and about 4 chapters of characters have been produced.
[b] 2. Visual effects[/b]
  A friend has reported that it is strange for enemies to disappear after a sudden "bang", so I improved the character disappearance effect and adjusted the animation duration to improve the look.
Of course, the screenshot below is not the final adjustment effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/36d50a61b33393effac80982a34aeb2d7a2d0def.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/5e7e2b07a35d439d6e3d53f6da93bcdd9cc97d82.jpg[/img]
[b] 3. Overall optimization[/b]
  Overall optimization is to eliminate a lot of unstable potential events recently, replaced by more specific binding events, which is also more ashamed, as an amateur developer did not understand these very well, but also recently learned.
  And the way enemies are hit is detected, theoretically consuming fewer resources and detecting more accurately than before.

The above is some of the content of this month's development, the beginning said that the work is busy, the private affairs are happening, in fact, it is not to say how hard they are, how difficult it is, but I think that life is actually chicken flying dog jumping is the norm, but in this normal state if we find what we want to do, then the pain caused by the chicken flying dog jumping will be alleviated, such as me, just thinking that I can leave work early, go home to finish eating, start developing games, and develop this game, every time I think of this, I feel that life is actually okay.
  I hope everyone can find what they want to do and hold on to their dreams in the chicken flying dog jump.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/c6083607c587c54af6ea5c782d86bc29a274f644.png[/img]

Producer
Carter Chang

notes.title: 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》July development log
notes.content:
Hello everyone, there are so many holidays this month!
But I still haven't rested, but there is some good progress, here to share with you ~

The September development focuses on 2 points:
One is to optimize the [b]enemy framework[/b],
Another one is to continue to produce [b]character animation assets[/b].

[h3][b]Enemy Frame 2.0[/b][/h3]
In fact, this problem also bothered me for a while, because after all, I am an amateur developer, and I have no development experience, so at first, in the demo when the character collision detection caused too much to cause the game to crash is also obvious to everyone, and then I fixed it can at least run, but this matter has always been a knot in my heart.
So this month I spent some time making drastic changes to the entire enemy framework, and also passed my personal stress test, and now will [b]no longer report the mistake of this basic problem[/b]!
I also optimize the parent class inheritance of the entire framework, optimize the event dispatcher, and make it easier to adjust the interaction with the level, which is very helpful for subsequent development efficiency.
Because this change is so gratifying, I'd like to call it [b]Enemy Framework 2.0[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/521ff4d61160770d46129e74be60281206fa92c9.png[/img]
[i]Enemy Frame 2.0 Family[/i]

[h3][b]Animated Assets[/b][/h3]
Another focus of the current is still animation material, recently because the animation material to do more, but also gradually found some ideas, than the previous production speed has improved, this month probably did [b]about 6 characters and 1 boss[/b],
Let's not release their appearance here first, after all, the enemy design still has some mystery!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/bfdffff5bc25ed16483b75d4f6d7ef64334312f7.png[/img]
[i]ChangYou held the stone[/i]

So far, there are[b] already 3 maps[/b] that have been made and run through, not including the prologue part of the playtest
[b]Follow-up maps are also being made.[/b]

Finally, I hope you will reap more joy and fruits in this harvest season!


Producer
Carter Chang
Weibo：黄金阿鲁卡多

notes.title: 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》July development log
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this month because of a lot of personal affairs, it can be said that from the second week of August until last week, I was in a hectic state, moving to another city, looking for a new job, so that the game development time in August plummeted, the development work can be said to be [b] "find idle in a busy state" time [/b], here and pay attention to and look forward to the 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》 friends can not say sorry.

However,  although it is "find idle in a busy state" development, but the development quality is [b] has not been reduced [/b] ~


[h3] Performance[/h3]
[b] 1. Fewer colliders and fewer collision detections. [/b]
Some logical enemies have been rebuilt, duplicate colliders have been reduced, especially the more complex boss characters have been optimized a lot, and now the phenomenon of the game crashing due to too much collision detection should be reduced. 
[img] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156286/1d9de1a7c6bcd143b46d2f13b5558b22f3826251.png[/img]
Refuse the game crash!

[h3] Arts[/h3]
[b] 1. Four enemy characters, two boss characters[/b]
Castlevania-like type game, there are too few enemies, and naturally, there will be a boring game, so the original enemy character is still one of the focus of the whole game, at present I have updated 4 enemies that have been installed, and 2 have been prepared material, and continue to make boss characters.

I believe that some friends have long been interested in the monsters I have designed, considering this problem, and then if I have enough time, I will send some news about the enemy separately, by the way, most of them come from our [b] Chinese "Classic of Mountains and Seas"! [/b] Also, they were all hand-drawn [/b] by me with my father[b]!

Well, I haven't actually developed much this month, so I'm sorry to you guys.

If you are interested in 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》, you can click [Apply for Test] on the store page to download the demo I made earlier! If you think it's fun, I hope you can add the game to the wish list and be busy promoting it to your friends, thanks!

notes.title: 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》July development log
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the July development progress report is here.

The main focus of development this month is [B] frames, bug fixes, and level [/b] continued development.

[h3]Performance[/h3]

1. This month, I learned a lot of development knowledge, consulted a lot of literature notes, and improved the frame number slightly. In the previous Cao Cao Boss battle Demo, I remembered that the average frame number was about 90fps, and now it can reach about 110fps (I have a 1070 graphics card).
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156286/542fe2c052d41cefa5e3928e08b27539f7995daa.png[/img]
The emphasis is on the top right

2. While continuing to develop the follow-up this month, I actually encountered some bugs that could not be solved before, but fortunately, this afternoon, I finally solved the last vicious bug so far, and the game can finally continue the follow-up development!

[h3]Arts:[/h3]

1. After finishing the design and installation of the boss in Chapter 1, do you still remember the "Big Tiger" DaoShou before? He can move now~
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156286/4fa2a520e35d9808985ae87da8500e9ead72a931.png[/img]
fierily DaoShou

2. The miscellaneous soldiers in the scene in Chapter 1 have also been designed and implemented. Since I am not an animator myself, it took me a lot of time to understand the motion law and bone structure of the enemies of dogs. Perhaps their animations are still not perfect at present, but I will continue to learn and modify them!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42156286/ba41bdcc1e2a5d047b3aef968b42273a600a7ab0.png[/img]
Prison guards and HuoDou

This month is mainly for these two aspects of work, the weather is very hot recently, and I feel dizzy, it is impossible to say not to delay the progress, but I will try to stay awake, and work hard to develop the game!

The producer
Carter Chang

notes.title: 《THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO》June development log
notes.content:
Since the game was announced in April, many friends have congratulated me and pointed out my shortcomings in the game to me. During this period, I have also improved the overall experience of the game. I also want to let more friends know the current progress of the game. Therefore, I plan to start in June and write down what I have done each month. Here is the main topic:

[h3]1. Art materials[/h3]
After April, I drew a lot of art materials, including enemies and scenes, because they were all painted by one person. Although my father helped to draw some original paintings, the final effect still had to be done by myself. It took a lot of time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/ac91f8d573021af60d5b6a61dc87f8073122927a.jpg[/img]
An original painting was designed with the help of my father.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/cda5800d15502b10b4a852e956d9b191f321fdfd.jpg[/img]
The second painting was adjusted by me.

[h3]2. Game system[/h3]
"Castlevania" has a "Guide System". Naturally, "THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO" should have a similar "Treasure system". 
In May, the "Treasure system" was developed. Some role functions are still under consideration and design, so they have not been designed all at once, and the treasure's icon has not been drawn, so there is no content to show for the time being.

[h3]3. overall performance[/h3]
I optimized the overall basic material, and the overall performance is improved compared with the previous demo version.

[h3]4. Overall vision[/h3]
The color has been re-colored and the scene has been reconstructed. While constantly experiencing the excellent works of the predecessors, of course, the aesthetics will gradually improve, and the picture will be more in line with the public aesthetics than before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/07389ab86e996e4933478d3cb7062f037db8fcc4.png[/img]
Before
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42182567/1e26fbdb3824a3f7a27d96fde0c59d2c908de6f9.png[/img]
Now

This is probably what I have been busy with in the past two months. To tell the truth, because I am currently in Shanghai, my income and mood have a great impact, and I have also lost my job (EH), but I still insist on making games and decide to write a log. In addition to letting more friends know the current development status of "THE ROMANTIC OF RIGHTEOUSNESS: SANGUO", I also want to pass on some positive energy, unremitting positive energy! Never give up hope for life!

Of course, I still have some interesting designs that haven't been released.

I hope everyone will like it when the game is released!

Producer
Carter Chang
Weibo：黄金阿鲁卡多

notes.title: April 1 stability update
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your support and feedback. The update is as follows:



[h1] Stability: [/h1]

- Adjusted enemy combat logic.

- Fixed a crash when stepping on CaoCao Boss.

[h1] Functional: [/h1]

- Reduced the reaction force of the rope and reduced the problem of swinging the rope out of the scene.

- Adjusted the repelling effect when enemies are attacked.

- Adjusted the impact of archers shooting arrows.

- Fixed an issue where enemies could chase down or slash players across stairs.

[h1] Scene: [/h1]

- Adjusted the air wall in Act 1.

- Tweaked 2nd act building ship collision of some planks.

- Tweaked individual platform collisions.

UI: [h1] [/ h1]

-UI dialogs added depth to background transparency.

- Fixed an issue where the blade shield Boss did not display health bars in act 2.

- Fixed an issue where there was no black screen after the building ship passed in Act 2.



I hope you can give more support to "the Romantic of Righteousness: SanGuo", I will continue to work hard to ensure the complete launch of the game!
